title: Device control-plane WebSocket envelopes
description: Server-to-client envelopes on /ws/connect for the device control plane. Auth contract: the device principal presents Authorization: Bearer <device_key> on the handshake only; a device_key (or any other) credential in the query string is rejected with close code 4001 before any subscription. Devices may hold only channel device:{device_id}; user JWT principals may never subscribe device:*. WebSocket delivery is a lossy hint: HTTP claim/log/result remains the authority. Frozen for epic #818 / M0.2 #828.

oneOf.$comment: Connect ack for a device principal, mirroring the existing user ack shape (userId) with deviceId instead.

channels.description: Effective channels; exactly the device's own device:{device_id} channel, which the server auto-subscribes. The server must verify the channel id matches the authenticated deviceId; any requested foreign channel is denied with an error envelope instead.

channel.description: Only the principal's own device:{device_id} channel can be acknowledged for a device.
Channel the failed subscribe/unsubscribe referred to, when applicable.

message.description: Access-denied or protocol error text. A denied subscribe answers with this envelope; it does not close the socket.

oneOf.$comment: Lossy wake-up hint published on device:{device_id} after a job create commits. The agent must still claim over HTTP; missing this message only costs latency (poll fallback).

job_id.description: device_jobs.id that is now claimable (status pending).

device_id.description: Target device; matches the channel's device id.
